sql: select 'order' k, o.market_ticker, o.side, o.action, o.limit_price::text px, o.quantity::text qty, o.status, o.created_at::text t from live_orders o where o.strategy like 'Alimm1%' and o.market_ticker like 'KXMCDSBIGMAC%' union all select 'pos', p.market_ticker, p.side, null, p.realized_pnl::text, coalesce(p.quantity_fp,p.quantity)::text, p.market_exposure::text, p.captured_at::text from (select distinct on (market_ticker) * from positions where market_ticker like 'KXMCDSBIGMAC%' order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) p order by 1,8
